target_customer: Fintechs, lenders and banks that need verified tax records for income verification
problem: Lenders and fintechs need verified income data, but obtaining IRS and tax software records is slow and manual.

founders.name: Fatih Celikbas
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Yale 20 and previously at Meta. Only one founder is listed though team size is 3.

competitors.name: PointServ
competitors.what: instant IRS tax transcripts through IVES

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating IRS online accounts and tax software logins plus OCR is fiddly and brittle but standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations take effort but rely on third party access and lenders have alternatives.

market_need_then: Lenders already paid for IRS transcript retrieval through IVES with multi-day turnaround, and real-time income verification was a gap.

branding.domain_note: Uses trychart.com, a prefixed domain, not chart.com.

identity.visual_style: clean modern, simple line icons, per website

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word and no press about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Chart is active with a product and customer logos, but no funding or exit was found in public sources, so the trajectory is unknown. Team listings show a single founder and a tiny team, and no verified round exists.
notes: VCBacked shows 500K USD pre-seed Apr 2023 but its description matches a different company, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitors dated near batch are thin. Outcome search found no acquisition or shutdown. Undated competitor omitted from the list: IRS IVES intermediaries such as Equifax Workforce Solutions.
